/* Fail_master_run_check : Exec_run_check 실패 시. Master 는 PENDING -> FAILED */
UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run
   SET status          = 'FAILED',
       child_total_cnt = 0,
       child_succ_cnt  = 0,
       child_fail_cnt  = 0,
       error_log       = left('[Exec_run_check] '
                              || '@{replace(activity('Exec_run_check').error.message, '''', '''''')}', 4000),
       end_dt          = now(),
       updated_by      = '@{pipeline().DataFactory}',
       updated_dt      = now()
 WHERE master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'
   AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING');

activities.name: Start_ingest_pipeline Script
activities.description: Master RUNNING 전환 + 수집 이력 PENDING 생성 (재시도 0)

text.value:
/* pl_raw_orch_incr_day > Script "Start_ingest_pipeline Script" (v8.3 INCR 전용, adf_script_v83_incr.sql 기반)
   Master PENDING -> RUNNING 전환 + 수집 이력(ctl_ingest_pipeline_run) PENDING 생성. Master 가 PENDING 이 아니면 (SKIPPED 등) 0건 반환
   대상 : Run Group(p_run_group_nm, RAW_INCR) 의 INCR 대상 (vw_ingest_exec_target), p_target_ids 로 일부만 수동 실행 가능
   증분 조건 : 증분컬럼 >= 시작일 (시작일 = pv_incr_from_val, 모든 대상 공통. 상한 없음, incr_to_val = NULL)
     pv_incr_from_val : p_incr_from_val 이 있으면 그 값, 없으면 오늘 - N 일 (형식 yyyy-MM-dd / yyyyMMdd, 시각 있는 형식도 허용)
     증분컬럼 유형 DATE / TIMESTAMP / STRING + 형식 (PostgreSQL to_char 형식). 그 외 유형은 즉시 실패
   DBX 전달 (GEN2) : load_method_cd = master.incr_load_method_cd. RANGE_DELETE_INSERT 는 range_column_nm = 증분컬럼, '>=', [YYYYMMDD] (월 형식 컬럼은 [YYYYMM])
   HWM : 자식 수집 파이프라인이 갱신 (이 스크립트는 관여 안 함)
   CDC / 경로 / 파일명 : FULL 스크립트와 동일. landing_path 없으면 incr/batch_date=YYYYMMDD/batch_hour=HH/pipeline_name=자식 파이프라인명
   즉시 실패 (형변환 오류 -> Script 실패 -> Fail_master_run) : INCR_FROM_VAL_INVALID:값 / INCR_COL_FORMAT_MISSING:target_id / INCR_COL_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED:target_id
   변경 : 수집 이력 INSERT 를 Master RUNNING 전환 시에만 수행 (SKIPPED Master 에서 수집되지 않도록), 전역 skip 은 run_check 가 처리, 감사 컬럼 updated_*
   Script 재시도 = 0. ADF 동적 식은 p CTE 에만 사용. 주석은 블록 주석만 사용 */
WITH p AS (
    SELECT '@{pipeline().RunId}'::text                                        AS master_run_id,
           '@{pipeline().parameters.p_run_group_nm}'::text                     AS run_group_nm,
           NULLIF('@{pipeline().parameters.p_target_ids}', '')::jsonb          AS target_ids,
           trim('@{variables('pv_incr_from_val')}')                            AS from_in,
           '@{variables('pv_yyyyMMddHHmmss')}'::text                           AS batch_str,
           '@{pipeline().DataFactory}'::text                                   AS created_by
),
/* 0. 시작값 검증 / 변환 (날짜 또는 분 단위 시각) */
d AS (
    SELECT p.*,
           CASE WHEN p.from_in ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'
                     THEN to_timestamp(p.from_in, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
                WHEN p.from_in ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} [0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(:[0-9]{2})?$'
                     THEN to_timestamp(rpad(p.from_in, 19, ':00'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
                WHEN p.from_in ~ '^[0-9]{8}$'
                     THEN to_timestamp(p.from_in, 'YYYYMMDD')
                WHEN p.from_in ~ '^[0-9]{12}([0-9]{2})?$'
                     THEN to_timestamp(rpad(p.from_in, 14, '0'), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
                ELSE to_timestamp(('INCR_FROM_VAL_INVALID:' || p.from_in)::int::text, 'YYYY')
           END::timestamp AS from_dt
      FROM p
),
/* 1. 대상 + 추출 위치 */
t0 AS (
    SELECT e.run_group_id, e.run_rule_id, m.*,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(m.cdc_tgt_db_nm), ''),     m.src_db_nm)     AS ext_db_nm,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(m.cdc_tgt_schema_nm), ''), m.src_schema_nm) AS ext_schema_nm,
           NULLIF(trim(m.landing_path), '')     AS landing_path_in,
           NULLIF(trim(m.file_nm_template), '') AS file_nm_template_in
      FROM p
      JOIN adfadm.vw_ingest_exec_target    e ON e.run_group_nm = p.run_group_nm AND e.run_type_cd = 'INCR'
      JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_target_master m ON m.target_id = e.target_id
     WHERE p.target_ids IS NULL
        OR e.target_id IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(p.target_ids)::bigint)
),
/* 2. 조건 / 자식 파이프라인명 / 경로 / 파일명 */
t AS (
    SELECT t0.*, x.pl_nm,
           /* 기록용 시작값 : 증분컬럼 형식 (DATE : YYYY-MM-DD, TIMESTAMP : YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS) */
           CASE WHEN upper(t0.incr_column_type) = 'STRING' AND NULLIF(trim(t0.incr_column_format), '') IS NOT NULL
                THEN to_char(d.from_dt, t0.incr_column_format)
                WHEN upper(t0.incr_column_type) = 'TIMESTAMP'
                THEN to_char(d.from_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
                ELSE to_char(d.from_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END AS from_val,
           /* DBX 범위 값 : 월 형식(일 없음) 컬럼은 YYYYMM, 그 외 YYYYMMDD */
           CASE WHEN upper(t0.incr_column_type) = 'STRING' AND t0.incr_column_format NOT ILIKE '%DD%'
                THEN to_char(d.from_dt, 'YYYYMM') ELSE to_char(d.from_dt, 'YYYYMMDD') END AS range_val,
           t0.incr_column_nm || ' >= ' ||
           CASE upper(t0.incr_column_type)
             WHEN 'DATE' THEN
                  CASE upper(t0.src_type)
                    WHEN 'DB2'   THEN 'DATE('''  || to_char(d.from_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ''')'
                    WHEN 'MSSQL' THEN 'CAST('''  || to_char(d.from_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ''' AS DATE)'
                    ELSE              'DATE '''  || to_char(d.from_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || '''' END
             WHEN 'TIMESTAMP' THEN
                  CASE upper(t0.src_type)
                    WHEN 'DB2'   THEN 'TIMESTAMP(''' || to_char(d.from_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || ''')'
                    WHEN 'MSSQL' THEN 'CAST('''      || to_char(d.from_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || ''' AS DATETIME2)'
                    ELSE              'TIMESTAMP ''' || to_char(d.from_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || '''' END
             /* 문자형 날짜 : 형식대로 변환 */
             WHEN 'STRING' THEN
                  CASE WHEN NULLIF(trim(t0.incr_column_format), '') IS NULL
                       THEN ('INCR_COL_FORMAT_MISSING:' || t0.target_id)::int::text
                       ELSE '''' || to_char(d.from_dt, t0.incr_column_format) || '''' END
             /* 그 외 유형 (NUMERIC 등) -> 형변환 오류로 Script 실패 */
             ELSE ('INCR_COL_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED:' || t0.target_id)::int::text
           END AS cond_sql,
           CASE WHEN t0.sink_type_cd <> 'GEN2' THEN NULL
                WHEN t0.landing_path_in IS NOT NULL THEN
                     replace(replace(replace(t0.landing_path_in,
                        '{batch_date}',  left(d.batch_str, 8)),
                        '{batch_hour}',  substr(d.batch_str, 9, 2)),
                        '{pipeline_nm}', x.pl_nm)
                ELSE 'incr'
                     || '/batch_date='    || left(d.batch_str, 8)
                     || '/batch_hour='    || substr(d.batch_str, 9, 2)
                     || '/pipeline_name=' || x.pl_nm
           END AS landing_path_out,
           CASE WHEN t0.sink_type_cd <> 'GEN2' THEN NULL
                WHEN t0.file_nm_template_in IS NOT NULL THEN
                     replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(t0.file_nm_template_in,
                        '{src_db}', t0.src_db_nm), '{schema}', t0.src_schema_nm), '{table}', t0.src_table_nm),
                        '{part}', ''), '{ts}', d.batch_str)
                ELSE t0.src_db_nm || '.' || t0.src_schema_nm || '.' || t0.src_table_nm
                     || '.' || d.batch_str || '.parquet'
           END AS file_name_out
      FROM t0 CROSS JOIN d
      /* 자식 파이프라인명 : pl_{data_class}_ingest_{src_type}_{추출 DB}  예) pl_raw_ingest_db2_MLCRP */
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT 'pl_' || lower(t0.data_class) || '_ingest_' || lower(t0.src_type)
                                 || '_' || upper(t0.ext_db_nm) AS pl_nm) x
),
/* 3. Master 이력 PENDING -> RUNNING (+ 대상 건수). SKIPPED 등 다른 상태면 0건 -> 수집 이력 생성 안 함 */
mst AS (
    UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run m
       SET status = 'RUNNING', start_dt = now(), updated_by = p.created_by, updated_dt = now(),
           child_total_cnt = (SELECT count(*) FROM t)
      FROM p
     WHERE m.master_run_id = p.master_run_id
       AND m.status = 'PENDING'
    RETURNING m.master_run_id
),
/* 4. 수집 이력 PENDING 생성 (Master 가 RUNNING 으로 전환된 경우만) */
ins AS (
    INSERT INTO adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
          (master_run_id, run_group_id, run_rule_id, target_id, ingest_pipeline_nm, run_type_cd,
           sink_type_cd, load_method_cd, range_column_nm, range_operator_cd, range_value,
           incr_policy_id, incr_column_nm, incr_from_val, incr_to_val,
           src_type, src_db_nm, src_schema_nm, src_table_nm, cdc_tgt_db_nm, cdc_tgt_schema_nm, data_class,
           extract_query, landing_path, file_name, sink_table_full_nm, status, created_by)
    SELECT p.master_run_id, t.run_group_id, t.run_rule_id, t.target_id, t.pl_nm, 'INCR',
           t.sink_type_cd,
           CASE WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2' THEN t.incr_load_method_cd END,
           CASE WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2' AND t.incr_load_method_cd = 'RANGE_DELETE_INSERT' THEN t.incr_column_nm END,
           CASE WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2' AND t.incr_load_method_cd = 'RANGE_DELETE_INSERT' THEN '>=' END,
           CASE WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2' AND t.incr_load_method_cd = 'RANGE_DELETE_INSERT'
                THEN jsonb_build_array(t.range_val) END,
           t.incr_policy_id, t.incr_column_nm, t.from_val, NULL,
           t.src_type, t.src_db_nm, t.src_schema_nm, t.src_table_nm,
           NULLIF(trim(t.cdc_tgt_db_nm), ''), NULLIF(trim(t.cdc_tgt_schema_nm), ''), t.data_class,
           /* 추출쿼리 : 템플릿 우선({WHERE} -> 증분 조건), 없으면 SELECT * (추출 위치 스키마) */
           CASE WHEN NULLIF(trim(t.src_query_template), '') IS NOT NULL
                THEN replace(t.src_query_template, '{WHERE}', t.cond_sql)
                ELSE 'SELECT * FROM ' || t.ext_schema_nm || '.' || t.src_table_nm
                     || CASE WHEN upper(t.src_type) = 'MSSQL' THEN ' WITH (NOLOCK)' ELSE '' END
                     || ' WHERE ' || t.cond_sql
                     || CASE WHEN upper(t.src_type) = 'DB2'   THEN ' WITH UR'       ELSE '' END
           END,
           t.landing_path_out,
           t.file_name_out,
           CASE WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'TABLE' THEN concat_ws('.', t.sink_db_nm, t.sink_schema_nm, t.sink_table_nm) END,
           'PENDING',
           p.created_by
      FROM t CROSS JOIN p
     WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mst)
    RETURNING ingest_pipeline_id, master_run_id, ingest_pipeline_nm, extract_query, landing_path, file_name,
              sink_table_full_nm, target_id, src_db_nm, src_schema_nm, src_table_nm,
              cdc_tgt_db_nm, cdc_tgt_schema_nm, sink_type_cd, load_method_cd,
              incr_column_nm, incr_from_val, range_value, status
)
/* 5. ForEach 입력 */
SELECT ingest_pipeline_id,
       master_run_id,
       ingest_pipeline_nm,
       extract_query,
       COALESCE(landing_path, '')       AS landing_path,
       COALESCE(file_name, '')          AS file_name,
       COALESCE(sink_table_full_nm, '') AS sink_table_full_nm,
       target_id, src_db_nm, src_schema_nm, src_table_nm, cdc_tgt_db_nm, cdc_tgt_schema_nm,
       sink_type_cd, load_method_cd, incr_column_nm, incr_from_val, range_value::text AS range_value, status
  FROM ins
 ORDER BY target_id;

activities.name: ForEach_child_ingest
activities.description: 수집 대상별 자식 수집 파이프라인 호출

text.value:
/* End_master_run : ForEach 완료 시 (성공 / 실패 모두). RUNNING 인 Master 만 갱신 (Fail_master_run 이 바꾼 행 · SKIPPED 는 유지)
   종료 시점에 RUNNING / PENDING 으로 남은 수집 행은 실패로 집계 */
WITH c AS (
    SELECT count(*)                                                        AS total_cnt,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SUCCEEDED')                    AS succ_cnt,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('FAILED','RUNNING','PENDING')) AS fail_cnt
      FROM adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
     WHERE master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'
       AND status <> 'SKIPPED'
)
UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run m
   SET child_total_cnt = c.total_cnt,
       child_succ_cnt  = c.succ_cnt,
       child_fail_cnt  = c.fail_cnt,
       status          = CASE WHEN c.fail_cnt = 0 THEN 'SUCCEEDED' ELSE 'FAILED' END,
       error_log       = CASE WHEN c.fail_cnt = 0 THEN m.error_log
                              ELSE '수집 실패 ' || c.fail_cnt || '건 (ctl_ingest_pipeline_run 확인)' END,
       end_dt          = now(),
       updated_by      = '@{pipeline().DataFactory}',
       updated_dt      = now()
  FROM c
 WHERE m.master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'
   AND m.status = 'RUNNING';

/* Fail_master_run : Start_ingest_pipeline Script 실패 시. 수집 이력 INSERT 실패면 같은 문장의 RUNNING 전환도 취소되어 Master 는 PENDING 으로 남아 있음 */
UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run
   SET status          = 'FAILED',
       child_total_cnt = 0,
       child_succ_cnt  = 0,
       child_fail_cnt  = 0,
       error_log       = left('[Start_ingest_pipeline Script] '
                              || '@{replace(activity('Start_ingest_pipeline Script').error.message, '''', '''''')}', 4000),
       end_dt          = now(),
       updated_by      = '@{pipeline().DataFactory}',
       updated_dt      = now()
 WHERE master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'
   AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING');

message.value: @{pipeline().Pipeline} 파이프라인 수행 중 Child Ingest Pipeline 수행 장애발생
